description: The system shall save the playlogs of the players.
Each playlog has a date, client, and player assigned.
The system shall save the connections of the players.
Each connection has a date, client, and player assigned.
The connection state can only be connected or not connected.
The system shall save the actions performed on the platform.
Each action has a date, client, user, and player assigned.
All actions are performed on an entity of the platform.
The system shall allow listing the different playlogs of the system.
The playlogs that the user can see will depend on the permissions they have.
All details of the playlog must be viewable.
The system shall allow listing the different connections of the system's players.
The connections that the user can see will depend on the permissions they have.
Connections can only have two states: connected or not connected.
The system shall allow listing the different actions performed on the different entities of the platform.
The actions that the user can see will depend on the permissions they have.
All actions must be related to an entity of the platform.
The system must respond quickly when the user performs any action.
The system responds to any user action in less than 5 seconds.
The system must be always available at all times, except for occasional events such as an update.
Any user must be able to access the platform at any time of the day, except during scheduled updates.
The system must be able to support an unlimited number of connections at the same time.
The platform scales dynamically with changes in simultaneous connections.
The system must be able to grow in capacity when the data volume increases.
The system scales automatically as data increases.
The project's functionalities must only be accessible to users with the corresponding permissions.
Users without permission cannot access data for which they do not have permission.
Confidential user information must be protected to ensure its privacy.
Users can only view the confidential data of their own user and no one else's.
